g.text: I take half-formed ideas and push them until they have a URL.
And then shipped nothing for nineteen months.
First two repos public in 48 hours
A Flask expense tracker and BunkerMe.
Litmus7 on-site and Cognifyz remote, plus the busiest month of commits.
All deployed, each behind a live URL.
Campus Hub, end to end in a week
Rotating QR check-in, hand-rolled auth, Postgres.
Two Kerala apps in one week
Sahi Daam for fair prices, Voc for Malayalam speech to English.
Graduating in 2027, and open to internships and junior roles.
